_note: Written by the Settings modal (live pill -> Settings) and read by tools/signal_alert.py and tools/event_alert.py on every poll. Safe to hand-edit; the UI rewrites the whole file, so a comment added here will not survive a save -- put explanations in the per-cell `note` field, which does. `grade` is the cell's measured standing against its own friction floor (tools/friction_map.py + the three-era table in the README): validated | marginal | below, shown on every message so a sub-friction alert never reads like a validated one; cells added from the UI are ungraded, the honest state for a cell nobody has measured. `strategy` is OPTIONAL and PER CELL: omit it and the cell runs its timeframe's default (sim.strategies.strategy_for_tf), name one and that cell runs that rule instead. It exists because the rule was previously chosen per TIMEFRAME globally, so USDJPY 4h was handed the rule validated on XAUUSD 4h -- and USDJPY 4h measured clearly negative under it. Only strategies in sim.strategies.BASELINES can be served live; tl_breakout needs a trendline/regime table and is research-only for now.
